description: Resource Type definition for AWS::Wickr::Network. Creates and manages an AWS Wickr network for secure enterprise communications.

NetworkArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the network.

NetworkId.description: The unique identifier of the network.

NetworkName.description: The name of the network. Must be between 1 and 20 characters.

AccessLevel.description: The access level of the network, which determines available features and capabilities.

AwsAccountId.description: The AWS account ID that owns the network.

Standing.description: The current standing or status of the network.

MigrationState.description: The SSO redirect URI migration state. Values: 0 (not started), 1 (in progress), or 2 (completed).
